analysis.title: The Global Point, Monday, 16 November 2026
key_insights: Nvidia CEO transition: Citi says Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, with Nvidia stressing continuity in existing product commitments. Citi's view is that the main risk to Taiwan's AI hardware supply chain is a slowdown in platform upgrades, not an immediate change in AI demand.

Citi expects products in development or nearing mass production in the next 1-2 years to be relatively insulated because of engineering milestones, supplier qualifications and customer commitments. Disruption to longer-term architecture decisions and supplier coordination would complicate the outlook from 2028 onward.

Citi sees leading Taiwan suppliers with customer diversity as resilient, naming TSMC and ASEH. Hon Hai is gaining share in ASICs. ASIC design service names Mediatek, GUC and Alchip may draw more investor attention.

BYD (1211.HK) after Citi's China Conference: Citi expects 4Q26E domestic net profit per car to be flat to slightly up QoQ. Drivers are better scale, product mix, falling lithium prices and clearance of first-generation blade battery inventory (1.5 months). Overseas net profit per car excluding forex is stable at about Rmb20k and should hold.

BYD management expects to offset the 4% cut in the export tax rebate and the 2% battery consumption tax hike with price increases on new overseas models, overseas dealer rebate changes and supply chain cost work. Overseas dealer rebates are 15-20% against about 5% domestically. Citi expects 4Q26E wholesales above 1.5mn units, with Nov and Dec growing MoM from October's 490k.

NAURA Technology (002371.SZ): slower 3Q26 revenue growth was mainly due to a key component shortage (such as mass flow controllers), which management says is almost solved through China-based sourcing. Management expects revenue growth to accelerate significantly in 4Q26.

NAURA new orders grew 60% YoY in 9M26, and management sees no sign of turning bearish in 2027 given stronger demand from China's leading memory makers. The one negative comment is that gross margin may hold at 40% rather than rise, because rising ASPs in China are unlikely.

CEZ (CEZP.PR): Citi argues a price on a possible disposal of up to 49% of CEZ Energy (Distribution and Supply) next year could expose how overvalued CEZ Power is. Assuming a 10-30% premium to 2027 RAB and 7-9x EV/EBITDA on Supply, Power Generation trades at 11.8-13.4x 2030E EV/EBITDA with a limited growth profile, against 7-8x historically for integrated CEZ.
If CEZ Energy starts at 4x net debt/EBITDA (valuing the 49% equity at CZK138-177bn), CEZ Holding could end up with leverage of 4-4.4x. Citi keeps Sell on CEZ and adjusts the target price to CZK910.

Brazil grains logistics (Citi, Rumo exposure): truckers' margins rose 1.11p.p. w-o-w and 4.18p.p. w-o-4w as freight tariffs followed diesel prices and grain exports strengthened. Soy and corn partial exports for the first week of November are growing double digits y-o-y. The Sorriso-Rondonopolis route is spiking, suggesting Rumo's pricing stays cheaper than competing routes, which Citi says supports Rumo's 4Q volumes.

Argentina utilities: higher country risk and the 2027 election pushed Citi to trim target prices on CEPU, PAM and TGS, while keeping Buy ratings. Citi thinks a significant portion of election risk is already priced in, leaving reasonable risk-reward.

CVC Brasil (CVCB3.SA): Citi resumes coverage at Neutral/High Risk. Headline leverage is only 0.5x LTM EBITDA excluding receivables discounting, but interest costs absorb cash generation. The latest debenture exchange extended maturities and cut the potential spread to CDI +3.9%, 60bps below existing debt costs. Citi says its blended valuation shows considerable upside but the return does not compensate for the risk.

Amaroq (AMRQ.L): Citi initiates at Buy/High Risk with a £2.20 target price. Gold output is forecast to rise from about 6koz in 2025 to over 110koz by 2032, with group EBITDA quadrupling to about $429mn. Nalunaq cash flow funds about $900mn of 2027-30 growth capex, and net debt peaks at about $348mn in 2030 before turning to net cash by 2032E.

Amaroq trades at 4.7x 2027E EBITDA, a discount of more than 50% to peers. Citi names Nalunaq ramp-up, Nanoq FID and the Black Angel study as re-rating catalysts, with a Bull Case of £5.3 and a possible 2035 Option Value of £10. Risks are gold prices, project execution and permitting.

European Media: after a resilient Q3 season and a favourable shift in AI positioning, Citi sees the sector entering 2027 in a two-way debate. Preferred picks are Informa, Scout24, Trustpilot and Wolters Kluwer.

Rating changes: Roblox cut to Neutral from Buy and Ypsomed cut to Neutral from Buy (target raised to SFr450 from 425). Prosus is back at Buy (target EUR51) after Rating Suspended. CVC Brasil is resumed at Neutral/High Risk (target R$1.00) and Amaroq is initiated at Buy/High Risk (target £2.20).

US target cuts above 10% (rating unchanged): Applied Materials to $580 from $710, Cerebras to $250 from $320, Cisco to $120 from $139, Nebius to $215 from $265, Rivian to $14.50 from $18, York Space Systems to $8 from $10, Candel Therapeutics to $20 from $26. EchoStar target rose to $139 from $117 and NielsenIQ to $19.50 from $16.

Overseas net profit per car excluding forex is stable at about Rmb20k this year. 4Q26E wholesales are expected above 1.5mn units (estimate) against October wholesales of 490k (reported).

tension_points.theme: CVC Brasil recovery vs debt cost
tension_points.bull_case: Citi's blended DCF/target multiple valuation yields considerable upside, and headline leverage is only 0.5x LTM EBITDA excluding receivables discounting.
tension_points.bear_case: Elevated interest costs absorb cash generation and constrain investment, and liability management has not resolved the equity story. The return does not compensate for the risk.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Cheaper refinancing, a faster-than-expected decline in the CDI, or a stronger operating recovery would be needed for meaningful upside.

tension_points.bear_case: Country risk has risen significantly and a knife-edge equilibrium narrative weighs on sentiment, so Citi trims target prices.
